description: Search the 10ML Fragrance Index for perfumes, colognes and fragrances (eau de parfum, eau de toilette, extrait) by name, house, notes, accords, family, audience, season, occasion or style. Natural language works: 'fresh citrus summer cologne for men' or 'warm vanilla scent for winter' is understood. Set iconic to true for only the editors' iconic, era-defining classics ('must-know perfumes for her', 'iconic winter scents'). Use when someone describes the scent they want, or names a perfume or house and you need matching fragrances. Not for the full profile of one known perfume (use get_perfume), not for 'something like X' (use find_similar_perfumes) and not for dupes or alternatives to a famous perfume (use find_perfume_alternatives). Returns ranked perfumes with house, year, family, accords, key notes, an editorial character line and 10ml.com links.

accords.description: Accords that must be present. Examples: ["woody","sweet"], ["fresh","aquatic"]

family.description: Fragrance family. Examples: "chypre", "fougere", "gourmand", "amber", "citrus". Leave term empty in explain_perfume_term to list every family.

gender.description: Audience the perfume is marketed to. men and women also include unisex perfumes.

house.description: Only perfumes from this house. Examples: "Dior", "Maison Francis Kurkdjian", "MFK", "YSL"

iconic.description: true = only the editors' iconic, era-defining classics (works with every other filter, and without a query)

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

notes_exclude.description: None of these notes may be present. Example: ["patchouli"]

notes_include.description: Every listed note must be present. Examples: ["oud","sandalwood"], ["vanilla"]

query.description: Free text: a perfume name, house, notes or mood. Examples: "fresh citrus summer for men", "Tom Ford oud", "vanilla gourmand for winter"

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

season.description: Season the perfume suits (fall is accepted in text queries as autumn).

style.description: A style word the scent should have.

name: search_perfumes
title: Search perfumes and fragrances
